title: Dynamical stability for dense patterns in attractor neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2507.10383v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recurrent neural networks are canonical models of biological memory. In these models, memories are represented by distributed patterns of neural activity that are stored in the recurrent connections between neurons, such that they become attractors of the network's dynamics. During memory recall, network dynamics thus converge toward one of these memory patterns when started from a noisy or partial cue. Therefore, memory performance critically hinges on the dynamical stability of the stored patterns. However, previous theoretical approaches only studied dynamical stability under highly restrictive conditions that do not readily apply to biological neural circuits. Here, we develop a theory of the local stability of discrete fixed points in a broad class of networks with graded neural activities and in the presence of noise. translated_title: 吸引子神经网络中密集模式的动力学稳定性
translated_abstract: 递归神经网络是生物记忆的经典模型。在这些模型中，记忆由神经活动的分布式模式表示，并存储在神经元之间的递归连接中，使其成为网络动力学的吸引子。在记忆回忆过程中，当网络从嘈杂或不完整的线索开始演化时，网络动力学会收敛到这些记忆模式之一。因此，记忆性能关键取决于存储模式的动力学稳定性。然而，以往的理论方法仅在高度限制性的条件下研究动力学稳定性，这些条件不易适用于生物神经回路。本文针对一大类具有分级神经活动且存在噪声的网络，发展了其中离散不动点的局部稳定性理论。利用随机矩阵理论的方法，我们分析了网络特征值谱的连续谱主体部分和离群特征值……
tldr: 该研究利用随机矩阵理论，为存在噪声且具有分级神经活动的吸引子神经网络发展了离散不动点的局部稳定性理论，突破了以往研究条件的限制，为理解生物记忆中密集存储模式的动力学稳定性提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: Using random matrix theory, this work develops a theory of local stability for discrete fixed points in attractor neural networks with graded activities and noise, overcoming the restrictive conditions of previous approaches and providing new insights into the dynamical stability of densely stored memory patterns.
